facts.fact: Club of Mozambique says M-PESA, E-MOLA and m-Kesh mobile wallets operate, with over 24.6 million digital wallet accounts in November per the Bank of Mozambique.
Club of Mozambique says METIX, officially launched 16 March 2026, integrates commercial banks and mobile wallets for real-time transfers, free for individuals.
Club of Mozambique says METIX, a single platform for banks and mobile wallets, was officially launched by the Bank of Mozambique on 16 March 2026 and all licensed entities must join.
